title: [review] wave-7 P3 bundle: delegation-table threading docs, /127 self-oracle residue, impersonation ratchet form
description: P3 bundle from wave-7 review: (1) rpl_dao_process.c:305-374 lichen_rpl_prefix_delegate/revoke/reset take no lock while the gate reads under dm->lock; single-operator constraint exists only in .c comment (273-275) - replicate in rpl_routing.h:376-425 docs or guard the four fns with the manager mutex. (2) lichen/tests/rpl_dao_auth/main.c:587 computes slash127_canonical via lichen_rpl_prefix_canonicalize (the function under test) then asserts the gate installs it - replace with a hand-written literal so the oracle is independent. (3) python/tests/crypto/test_orphan_vector_consumers.py:122-139 asserts (True, None) for the dodagid_mismatch impersonation vector (current-insecure behavior) as a passing test - convert to pytest.xfail(strict=True) so the ratchet is visible in reports, and confirm the DODAGID-binding-check bead exists (13m9 filed this wave).
